finding: A programmed-stage projection needs a deterministic digest over the exact projection, repertory slot, production metadata, public stage card, and activation boundaries before it can be used as retained programming evidence.
claim_boundary: This proves deterministic local attestation behavior for the committed module and fixtures. It does not prove runtime integration, deployment, browser rendering, audio routing, or physical-device behavior.
privacy_boundary: No private source material, worker controls, credentials, or user data are present.
rollback_route: Do not consume the attestation module; canonical repertory and public stage cards remain unchanged.
